title: Borrow wisely
intro: Borrowing money has a price. This Lesson shows how to read that price. It also shows how lenders decide what to charge you.

check.prompt: A loan's APR and its interest rate are always the same.
check.explanation: Myth. The APR adds the lender's fees to the interest rate.

check.prompt: Hoa's credit score goes up. What usually happens to the rates lenders offer her?
check.explanation: They go down. A higher score usually means a lower rate.

check.prompt: Each person has just one credit score.
check.explanation: Myth. Your score can differ by the model, the data and the day.
